staleness.method: manifest.dirty must be false; manifest.source_commit == change_set.base; working tree must be clean (a receipt in diff mode describes committed history only); content_hash of every whole-file node (code_unit, document, receipt; deployable_unit via its package.json) must equal the sha256 of the file bytes at base (git objects); contract/route/data_model hashes are extractor-owned (declaration text) and not recomputed

impact_set.method: Union of independently revision-bound base/head traversals; global fallback: every node of the graph is affected (depth 0, synthetic containment hop); reverse traversal (dependents) + forward declared-by hops (provides_route, implements_contract, maps_model of the same file, deploys_to); best path = fewest inferred/observed hops, then shortest; max_depth 3

global_fallback.reason: tsconfig.json changed ⇒ every node affected (lockfile / global config / env schema: safe fallback, Bazel/Nx practice)
